products.body: Watch caps were issued to sailors standing watch: hours on deck, in the dark, in weather, with nothing to do but pay attention. Ours is knit from 100% cashmere, two ends of yarn twisted into one for density and a cap that survives a season of being pulled on and shoved in a pocket. Deploy on dreich mornings waiting for the frost to burn.

products.title: Yeoman's Performance Short
products.body: A yeoman held land he worked himself. Not gentry. Not tenant. The man who did the thing. The short is cut for that. Room through the seat and thigh — enough to walk eighteen, to bend over a bag, to sit in a cart without the fabric arguing back. Relaxed, not loose. Lightweight four-way stretch micro dobby. This is a true workhorse designed to deliver. With an 8.5 inch inseam, this short is designed to hit just above the knee.

products.title: Hudson Hoodie
products.body: Lightweight. Warm. Sleek. The Hudson Hoodie is cut from a UPF 50+, moisture wicking fabric designed to perform year round. A micro peached interior delivers an ultra soft and comfortable hand, while a tonal mesh lining in the hood provides subtle contrast. A 1×1 rib half-cuff keeps sleeves steady through the swing, and a discreet back right zip pocket positioned eliminates distracting bulk. Stash a scorecard, glove, or ball marker and swing away. Interlock knits offer a more considered take on traditional rib constructions. Engineered as a double-knit, it’s created by knitting two layers together simultaneously, resulting in a fabric with greater structure, stability, and depth. The hand is slightly more substantial without feeling heavy, with natural stretch and a more refined finish than standard performance knits.

products.title: Hudson 3-Button Polo with brrr°
products.body: Long ago, golf balls were made of wood. The savviest players discovered that scratched, weathered balls flew straighter. That realization ignited one of the greatest innovations in the game's history: dimples. They made shots straighter, faster, farther. Simply put, dimples make the difference. So we made our own. The Dimple Print Polo. The classic Hudson, in an aerodynamic print. The Hudson 3-Button Polo is the one you reach for without thinking. Engineered from quick-dry, breathable four-way stretch fabric, it moves effortlessly with you from first tee to last light. Sew-in collar stays and a lightweight fusible give the collar quiet structure, maintaining a clean, refined look throughout the day.

products.title: Hudson Pull On Short
products.body: The Hudson Pull-On Short in Steel Grey is built for the way you play, and the way you live between rounds. Engineered as true performance golf shorts, the athletic fit and four-way stretch construction move with you from the first tee to the 19th hole. The pull-on waistband eliminates bulk without sacrificing structure. In a clean steel grey that pairs with everything, these stretch golf shorts bring a quiet confidence to your game. No compromises. No distractions. Just better golf.

products.title: Hudson Pull On Short
products.body: The Hudson Pull-On Short delivers a refined balance of comfort and performance. An elastic waistband and stretch fabric provide ease of movement, while belt loops and a tailored above-the-knee fit offer a polished look that transitions effortlessly beyond the course. Designed with a 7 inch inseam. Take your true size, relax, and swing easy.

products.title: Hudson Pull On Short
products.body: The Hudson Pull-On Short in Black is the golf short that does it all. Designed for men who expect more from their gear, these men's golf shorts deliver performance where it counts and style that carries beyond the course. The clean black colorway keeps things sharp, while the pull-on construction and stretch fabric make them equally at home as casual golf shorts on a weekend round or a low-key afternoon. Refined. Reliable. Ready.

products.title: Hudson 5-Pocket Pant
products.body: Five-pocket is a name, not a number. Two front. Two back. And a watch pocket no one has put a watch in for a hundred years. The Hudson has six. The sixth sits flat and internal, sized to a yardage book — or a scorecard that comes home the way it left the first tee. Water-repellent. Four-way stretch. A bonded waistband that lies flat under a tucked shirt.

products.title: Hudson 5-Pocket Pant
products.body: A refined take on the classic five-pocket, engineered for performance and elevated for everyday wear. Crafted from water-repellent, four-way stretch fabric with a lightweight bonded waistband, it delivers unrestricted movement with a clean, tailored feel. A discreet internal pocket keeps course essentials close at hand, while understated detailing and a modern tapered silhouette make it equally at home off the course.

products.title: Malta Short
products.body: An essential for peak summer conditions, the Malta Short is designed with a bonded elastic waistband for enhanced comfort and ease. Cooling performance properties and a clean back yoke maintain a polished look, while a snap-button waist closure offers a streamlined alternative to traditional constructions. With an 8.25 inch inseam, the Malta Short was designed to hit just above the knee.

products.title: Malta Short
products.body: Some rounds you play. Some you survive. August, one o'clock, no wind. The Malta is cut for that — slim through the hips and pockets, nothing extra to hold heat. The waistband is bonded rather than sewn, so there's no stack of fabric at the belt line, no seam pressing back at you by the twelfth. A snap closes it. No button to work at with wet hands. Cooling fabric. Sits flat across the seat, and stays there when you bend to read a putt. 8.25" inseam. Just above the knee.
